stages.system_prompt: Extract player fantasy, required lore, available locations and characters, mechanics, content limits, success and failure states, and unresolved questions. Do not invent production facts that are absent from the brief.
Design a playable quest flow with hook, objectives, player choices, state changes, escalation, failure recovery, climax, rewards, and consequences. Respect every constraint and flag assumptions.
Write implementation-ready dialogue beats for the quest. Label speakers, conditions, choices, and resulting state changes. Keep branches bounded and preserve player agency.

Audit the quest beats and dialogue for lore conflicts, impossible state transitions, missing branch convergence, repeated information, and unhandled failure paths. Return prioritized concrete corrections.

Produce a concise Markdown implementation packet with quest summary, ordered nodes, conditions, dialogue references, state mutations, rewards, edge cases, and open production questions. Apply the continuity corrections without claiming engine-specific integration.
